summary: Two volunteers take charge of delivering the campaign paper together with a published profile of the candidate.
realLife: Peters credited Rowan and Kennedy with distributing a tabloid and a magazine account across Kanawha County.
gates: The campaign has copies available to distribute.
inGame: needs: a literature inventory and a delivery record that distinguishes the two publications.

turns.what: The volunteers deliver the campaign paper alone on the last block.
turns.pulledBy: They have fewer copies of the profile than of the paper.
turns.writesBack: The route sheet identifies where only one item went out.

turns.what: The volunteers hold the boxes for the second delivery.
turns.pulledBy: The profile was promised for the following morning.
turns.writesBack: The distribution date shifts and the inventory stays at headquarters overnight.
